page.layout: One column of running text, full width; at the left edge, the gutter and edge of the neighbouring page (not transcribed); below the text, the page number with an ornament and the catchword at the right.

main_text.l: nonnulli per omnia, alij tantum de
la, in qua fatetur, nihil additum in
in posterum, ne quid addatur. Quæ

page.notes: The first word is partly cut off at the top left ("mihi" reads as "mine" in the scan; copied as printed as "mihi" is uncertain: the first letters are visible only as "mi"). The left-edge fragments belong to the neighbouring page and are left out. The ornament before the page number is a printer's mark and is not transcribed as text. "Nicolai" is read with a doubtful letter form in the scan. Long s printed as f in the scan ("Schifmatici", "exofculantur", "fatetur") is transcribed as s.
